claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectMaterial.stone
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stone Shape targets a stone object or section of stone. The ObjectFilter.material field only accepts 'metal' | 'flammable'; 'stone' is absent from OBJECT_MATERIALS.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reshape_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stone Shape transforms an existing stone object into an arbitrary player-defined form at cast time. alter_item_kind requires a fixed authored newKind string (a pre-specified destination form like 'rowboat'). Stone Shape's destination is open-ended — the player chooses any shape — so no closed newKind value can be authored. A new atom is needed for open-ended material reshaping of an existing object, distinct from alter_item_kind (fixed destination) and create_object (creates new matter from nothing).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through a wall that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut.

discrepancies: no content/stone_shape.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
